title: feat(app-shell,data-objectstack): a refused dashboard or list view opened by URL says it was refused (objectui#12112)
body:
Fixes #12112
Clause-②: yes

The console half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#22611's ruling A (director's ruling `6095014058`), as triage `6103491895` scoped it. Dispatched by the `domain:ui#2` seat; claim `6109832410`; implementing session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01TYgwmFK1q4KJ6Qq2WRLzsD`.

## What changes

Since objectstack-ai/objectstack#22731 (`5081090b71`) the server lists only the dashboards and list views a caller may open, and refuses a by-name read of one they do not hold with `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` and the sentence `You do not have permission to open the 'NAME' dashboard.` (or `view`). The console read only the lists.

- **Dashboard URL** (`DashboardView`). A dashboard missing from the caller's list is now asked by name once the list has loaded. A `PERMISSION_DENIED` answer shows the refusal: the title "You don't have access" (`dashboard.widgetForbiddenTitle`, an existing key) and, under it, the server's own sentence, which names the dashboard. Every other answer (`not_found`, `unreachable`, `granted`) keeps today's "Dashboard Not Found". While the list is still loading, the page now shows its skeleton instead of a premature "not found".
- **List view by name** (`ObjectView`). A requested view id that misses the merged view list is asked by name, by its canonical `OBJECT.KEY` name (a short name is the key). A `PERMISSION_DENIED` answer replaces the list area, in both layouts (the plain list and split navigation), with "You don't have access" (`list.loadErrorForbiddenTitle`, an existing key) and the server's sentence; no switcher tab is marked active. Every other answer keeps today's fall-back to the default view.
- **The by-name door** (`@object-ui/data-objectstack`). `ObjectStackAdapter.probeMetaItemAccess(type, name)` is the existing `probeAppAccess` door, widened to a type parameter: the same `client.meta.getItem` read, the same verdicts, read off the `PERMISSION_DENIED` code and never off the status. It also returns the refusal's `message` with a `denied` verdict. `probeAppAccess` now delegates to it and answers exactly as before (its pin file is unchanged and green).
- **One reader for both pages**: `useMetaItemRefusal` (`packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useMetaItemRefusal.ts`) asks once per missed name, holds the answer with the name it is about, caches nothing across mounts, and asks nothing in draft preview or when the host adapter has no probe (the same two skips `AppContent` makes for its app probe).

`Clause-②: yes`: `@object-ui/data-objectstack` exports a new interface, `MetaItemAccess`, and `ObjectStackAdapter` gains a public method, `probeMetaItemAccess`; no translation key is added. The refusal's sentence is the server's, shown untranslated, as `metadataReadWarningToast` already does for server text.

## Mechanism readings (the dispatch's hypotheses, measured)

- **H1, confirmed.** `DashboardView` resolves the dashboard from the `/meta/dashboard` LIST (`preferLocal(dashboards, …)`), so a refused dashboard is absent and fell into the not-found branch. Proven on BASE by the new pin, run before the view was edited: `Unable to find an element by: [data-testid="dashboard-access-denied"]`, with `empty.dashboardNotFound` and `empty.dashboardNotFoundDescription` in the DOM. The same pin run showed the not-found face also renders while the list is still `loading`.
- **Where the `403` was lost.** `@objectstack/client` keeps it: its fetch stamps `error.code` from `body.error.code`, `error.httpStatus` and `error.message`. The console flattened it in two places: `MetadataProvider.getItem` resolves `null` on any failure (so `useMetadataItem`'s `error` slot is never filled), and the adapter's `getView` / `getApp` / `getPage` resolve `null` too. `probeAppAccess` was the one by-name door that read the code, for apps only, so that is the door this widens rather than adding a second fetch path.
- **H2, measured.** A refused view id opened by URL fell back SILENTLY to the default view: BASE pin DOM shows `data-active-view="clm_contract.default"` and the console warning `Requested view "clm_contract.legal_review" not found …; falling back to the default view`.
- **H3, the D4 class, measured: listed, and served — nothing refuses it.** For a `studio.access` holder without a view's capability:
  - a view that is a `/meta/view` item (an item, or a container's expanded entry) is pruned from `/meta/view` for every caller (`createMetaListReadGate`'s `view` arm has no D4 exemption) and is never in the switcher;
  - an object's OWN `listViews` entry is served whole inside `/meta/object` to a caller who may edit the object (`isObjectSchemaMaskExempt`), so the console's switcher lists it (`mergeViewsIntoObjects` keeps the object's entries, `buildViewTabs` draws them) and it opens. There is no by-name `/meta/view` item for such an entry (the server's own pin fixture, `meta-view-dashboard-audience-gate.test.ts`, has `legal_desk` only inside the object), so a by-name read answers absence, not a refusal. The triage premise "the by-name read refuses it" does not hold for this path. The spec describe says the same: an object's own list views are pruned "for a user who may not edit the object".
  - ⛔ No client rule was added. The pin `D4 (measured)` holds that the entry is listed, opens, and nothing is asked or refused.
- **H4.** No dashboard- or view-level refusal key exists; the two titles reused are `dashboard.widgetForbiddenTitle` and `list.loadErrorForbiddenTitle` ("You don't have access", present in all ten packs). The item is named by the server's sentence.

## Pins

- `DashboardView.refusal-12112.test.tsx`: a refused dashboard URL (with and without a sentence); CONTROL a held dashboard opens as today and asks nothing; CONTROL `not_found` / `unreachable` / `granted` keep "not found"; CONTROL a host adapter with no probe; CONTROL draft preview asks nothing; nothing is asked or said while the list is loading.
- `ObjectView.viewRefusal-12112.test.tsx`: a refused list view by name (plain and split navigation), a short name asked canonically; CONTROL a held view opens by name and asks nothing; CONTROL a missing view falls back to the default; the D4 reading.
- `metaItemAccessProbe-12112.test.ts`: the adapter over the real client and a stubbed fetch: a refused dashboard and a refused view (`denied` + sentence, by-name address), the item-less 200, a served item, a 403 without the code, empty inputs, and `probeAppAccess` as the same probe.

## Verification

- **BASE reading** (the new view pins, run before either view was edited): 9 failed / 5 passed. The refused dashboard rendered `empty.dashboardNotFound`; the refused view rendered `data-active-view="clm_contract.default"`.
- **Build**: `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^... --concurrency=2`, 28/28 tasks, on `1104e4a`.
- **Type-check** on `1104e4a`: `@object-ui/data-objectstack` `tsc --noEmit` exit 0 (its file set includes the new pin, per `tsc --showConfig`); `@object-ui/app-shell` `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exit 0 (the test config includes `src/**/*.test.tsx`, so both new view pins are type-checked).
- **Pins, neighbours and ratchets** on `1104e4a`: the three new pin files, `appAccessProbe.test.ts`, the four existing `DashboardView.*` pins, `AppContent.deniedVsUnpublished` and `AppContent.missingRecheckKeying`, `column-identity.ratchet` and `one-authority-per-exported-name-6273`: 12 files, 98 tests passed.
- **Ablation** on `8e35d3c`, each leg through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 to 0, blob changed, restore proven: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty), with an EXIT/INT/TERM restore trap:
  - leg A, the hook's `denied` branch made unreachable: 5 red (both dashboard refusal cases, the view refusal in plain and split navigation, the short-name case); every CONTROL green.
  - leg B, the adapter's `PERMISSION_DENIED` branch made unreachable: 5 red (the dashboard and view `denied` cases, `probeAppAccess` as the same probe, and two `probeAppAccess` `denied` cases in `appAccessProbe.test.ts`, which shows the app probe now goes through the widened door).
  - restore leg: the four pin files 39/39 green.
- **Whole suites** on `8e35d3c`: `packages/app-shell/` 1,272 files (1 skipped), 12,314 tests passed and 9 skipped (8 shards; shards 5 to 8 exceeded the shard timeout under load and were re-run as twelve 53-file chunks, whose file lists were checked identical to vitest's own sequencer's); `packages/data-objectstack/` 83 files, 1,109 tests; `scripts/__tests__/` 4 shards, 182 files (2 skipped), 5,489 tests passed and 2 skipped.
- **Declared narrowing**: the whole-suite runs above were not repeated after the `faf4ce9` merge; the post-merge reading is the 12-file set above plus both type-checks. CI runs the full suites.
- **Repo gates** on `1104e4a`: `check-changeset-presence`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, the three `check:vi-mock-*`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:unreferenced-sources` and `docs:check-links`: all exit 0.
- **Lint**: `eslint` (inline config honoured) on the seven touched source and test files: 0 errors; 306 warnings, 0 of them on an added line.
- **NOT MEASURED**:
  - `check:doc-snippets`: PRECONDITION NOT MET (exit 2), it needs a 34-package build; CI's doc-snippet workflow builds it. It now covers the new `ts` fence in the adapter README.
  - `check:readme-exports`: exit 1 for 94 self-imports in 8 packages outside the built closure ("could not be judged"). The judged part, the adapter README included, reads 0 fabricated and 0 wrong-path.
  - Console eager-closure delta: two console builds under a contended lock. The adapter (eager) gains one method and one interface; the two views and the hook are route code.
  - The i18n family is not owed: no pack moved.

## Acceptance notes

- **The D4 reading** above is the card's item 2. The switcher lists an object's own gated list view to a caller who may edit the object, and it opens. No refusal exists for the console to surface, and nothing was added to hide it.
- **While the dashboard list is still loading**, the page now shows its skeleton rather than "Dashboard Not Found". Before, a cold load briefly said "not found" for every dashboard. The refusal needs a settled list, so this is part of the change, not a separate fix.
- **Noted, not filed (read, not run; no carrier):** `MetadataProvider.getItem` resolves `null` on every failure, and its `extractItem` returns the whole envelope as the item when the by-name answer carries no `item` key. That is the server's `200` for a name with nothing behind it. A cold `useMetadataItem(type, absentName)` would therefore hold an envelope as if it were the document. Nothing in this change reads `getItem`.
